pet_notes: Reimagine Seedy as an extra-cute tiny pixel-art sprout bot inspired by the user reference: a warm cream rounded-square seed-pod/CRT-style head with a softly inset pale face panel, two tiny dark square eyes, rosy pink pixel cheeks, a very small simple mouth or no mouth, a short brown stem, and two bright fresh green leaves. Tiny cream body with stubby arms and feet plus a small green seed emblem on the chest. Compact chibi proportions: oversized head, very small body, gentle shy expression. Preserve as a unique Seedy character rather than copying the reference exactly.
style_notes: Authentic hand-placed 16-bit pixel art with a deliberately low-resolution grid, crisp hard pixel clusters, no antialiasing, limited cream/tan/brown/leaf-green/pink palette, one-pixel dark-brown outline, minimal two-tone shading, and a cute cozy game-sprite finish. No smooth vector curves, painterly rendering, 3D, gradients, or high-resolution line art.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `pixel`: Pixel-art-adjacent digital mascot with a chunky silhouette, simple dark outline, limited palette, flat cel shading, and visible stepped edges.
